about: Every reason the public directory's checks can fail a submission, on top of the package reasons in reasons.json. The kit's review.py gives them, in check.yml for each pull request and in publish.yml again on main.

reasons.meaning: A file is a picture, an icon, a PDF or a font, by its name or by its first bytes. Or its text holds '<svg' or 'data:image/'.
A file is a binary: it has a NUL byte, isn't UTF-8, or has a binary file's extension.
The submission has no README.md, or no LICENSE, LICENSE.txt or LICENSE.md. Or the pull request changes a path outside addons/ and revoked.json.
A file isn't inside addons/<id>/<version>/, or the manifest's id or version doesn't match its folders.
The version isn't above the last one listed, or the pull request changes a version that is already listed.
The id is listed already under another author's url.
The add-on mentions or links to a payment, a tip or a paid version.
The manifest, README or changelog mentions points, streaks, ranks, badges, levels or a leaderboard.
A net.fetch call names a host that isn't in the manifest's hosts, or an address that isn't https://.
A file has a run of base64 longer than 1,024 characters.
A .js file has a line longer than 500 characters.
revoked.json isn't valid: see the format in addons/spec/directory.md.
